text: It depends on the building. Anything with real historical or architectural value should definitely be protected, because once it's knocked down, it's gone forever. In Almaty, for example, some beautiful wooden houses from the early twentieth century have already disappeared. But not every old building is worth saving — some are simply unsafe, and replacing them with modern housing makes more sense.

tips.en: Historical or architectural value gives a test, not just yes or no.
tips.kk: Historical or architectural value — «иә/жоқ» емес, белгі бойынша жауап.
tips.ru: Historical or architectural value — ответ по признаку, а не «да/нет».
tips.example: Anything with real historical or architectural value should definitely be protected

tips.en: Once it's knocked down, it's gone forever is a strong argument.
tips.kk: Once it's knocked down, it's gone forever — күшті дәлел.
tips.ru: Once it's knocked down, it's gone forever — сильный довод.
tips.example: once it's knocked down, it's gone forever

questions.question: Should old buildings be preserved or replaced with modern ones?

text: Mainly to put the city on the map. A striking building can attract tourists, investors and international events, and it gives the city a recognisable symbol for postcards and advertising. Bilbao is the classic example — one art museum turned it into a tourist destination. The risk, though, is that governments spend huge sums on prestige projects while ordinary neighbourhoods lack basic facilities.

tips.en: Bilbao is a well-known example that supports the point.
The risk, though adds the other side at the end.
tips.kk: The risk, though — соңындағы екінші жағы.
tips.ru: The risk, though — вторая сторона в конце.
tips.example: The risk, though, is that governments spend huge sums on prestige projects

phrases.text: put the city on the map

questions.question: Why do cities build famous landmark buildings?

text: For me, natural light is the most important thing. Offices with no windows or tiny ones can make people feel tired and low, even if everything else is modern. Good sound insulation matters too — there's nothing worse than hearing your neighbours' conversations through the wall. And I think small green spaces, like a courtyard or a roof garden, make a huge difference to how people feel.

tips.en: The most important thing starts with the key point.
tips.kk: The most important thing — жауап ең маңыздысынан басталады.
tips.ru: The most important thing — ответ начинается с главного.
tips.example: natural light is the most important thing

tips.en: There's nothing worse than is emotional and natural.
tips.kk: There's nothing worse than — эмоционалды әрі табиғи.
tips.ru: There's nothing worse than — эмоционально и естественно.
tips.example: there's nothing worse than hearing your neighbours' conversations

text: To a large extent, yes. If you look at the business districts of Dubai, Shanghai or Astana, you see the same glass towers and the same international chains on the ground floor. I understand why — it's cheaper and faster to build that way. But it's a pity, because a city's character usually comes from its local style, and that's exactly what tourists travel to see.

tips.en: Dubai, Shanghai and Astana give proof instead of general words.
tips.kk: Дубай, Шанхай, Астана — жалпы сөз орнына дәлел.
tips.ru: Дубай, Шанхай, Астана — доказательство вместо общих слов.
tips.example: If you look at the business districts of Dubai, Shanghai or Astana

tips.en: I understand why … but it's a pity gives balance.
tips.kk: I understand why … But it's a pity — теңгерім.
tips.ru: I understand why … But it's a pity — баланс.
tips.example: But it's a pity, because a city's character usually comes from its local style

text: I'd say it's essential now. Buildings use an enormous amount of energy for heating, cooling and lighting, so even small improvements can have a big impact. In a country like Kazakhstan, where winters are long and much of the heating still comes from coal, better insulation alone could cut pollution significantly. Solar panels and smart heating systems are great too, but insulation is the simplest place to start.

tips.en: An enormous amount of energy explains why it matters.
tips.kk: An enormous amount of energy — бұл неге маңызды.
tips.ru: An enormous amount of energy — почему это важно.
tips.example: Buildings use an enormous amount of energy

tips.en: Coal and long winters are an example from the speaker's own country.
tips.kk: Көмір және ұзақ қыс — өз елінен мысал.
tips.ru: Уголь и долгая зима — пример из своей страны.
